# Marvelous Clawds (formerly Clawdvengers: Clawd Wars)

> The showcase page for Marvelous Clawds, the comic-book universe of Clawd Clash (https://github.com/rodclemen/clawd-clash), a free macOS app that shows Claude Code, Codex, Qwen Code, Gemini CLI and GitHub Copilot CLI sessions as pixel-art heroes and villains fighting on your desktop or in a window. This repo holds no code: only the README, pictures, the promo video and a plain-language changelog. The app, its source and its full history live in the Clawd Clash repo.

- Marvelous Clawds has 193 characters (105 heroes, 88 villains) and 43 places, all with parody names: Iron Clawd, Captain Americlawd, Thorr, Spider-Clawd, Clawdverine, Thanoz, Lokee, Clawdvengers Tower, Wakandu, Asgaard, the Clawdjet and the Milano.
- Install: `brew tap rodclemen/tap && brew trust rodclemen/tap && brew install --cask marvelous-clawds` installs Clawd Clash starting in Marvelous Clawds (`brew trust` only on newer Homebrew); `brew install --cask clawd-clash`, or https://github.com/rodclemen/clawd-clash/releases.
- The other universes: Star Clawds (https://github.com/rodclemen/star-clawds) Detective Clawds (https://github.com/rodclemen/detective-clawds) and Doctor Clawd (https://github.com/rodclemen/doctor-clawd).

## Docs

- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): what changed in the Marvelous Clawds universe, in plain words.
